applicability: Friis free-space RF link budget checking whether a wireless audio link closes with adequate margin above a declared receiver sensitivity at a given distance
assumptions: free-space propagation with no multipath, obstruction or body-worn attenuation
ideal antenna orientation for the declared gains
excluded: real-environment path loss (multipath, obstruction, body-worn attenuation)
uncertainty: Standard textbook RF engineering (Friis 1946); hand-verified before use (2.4 GHz, 4 dBm tx, 0 dBi antennas, 10 m -> Pr=-56.05 dBm).
limits_policy: A link that does not close above the declared receiver sensitivity is flagged rather than assumed to work.
